notes.subject: a masaya daminɛ na
notes.rationale: במלכו infinitive construct: 'in his reigning' — Bamanankan needs a clause

notes.subject: den san wolonwula
notes.rationale: MT reads 'a son of seven years was Jehoash when he began to reign'; some English Bibles shift the accession date here instead ('in the seventh year of Jehu'), following a different verse division

translation: Den san wolonwula de ye Yehoash (Yowasu) ye ⟨a masaya daminɛ na⟩.
